messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — we have a coverage gap for EU late-night this Sunday (22:00-06:00 UTC). Priyanka is OOO and Samir flagged a travel conflict. Need a last-minute primary or primary+secondary swap. Can anyone pick up at least the primary window?

Oncall Bot: Reminder: scheduled on-call for 1961234567 slot: Primary=Priyanka Rao, Secondary=Samir Patel. Please update if swapping.

Maya Singh: I can take primary from 22:00 until 02:00 UTC (short window). Not ideal for full night but I can cover the high-risk early part. Can someone take 02:00-06:00?

Samir Patel: I can do 02:00-06:00 if travel plans shift earlier, but not guaranteed. If Samir is uncertain, we need another volunteer.

Alex Chen: Ok — I can take 02:00-06:00 if need be, but I'll be in transit evening -> midnight (no reliable phone). I'm +1 for 02:00 handoff. Maya, if you take primary 22:00-02:00 I'll be secondary on-call until I takeover at 02:00.

Priyanka Rao: Thanks for the callouts. I'm updated as OOO in PagerDuty. I'm grateful for the handoff offer. Please follow the EU-night runbook and escalate SEV1 immediately.

Maya Singh: Confirmed then: I'll be primary 22:00-02:00 (covering first-in alerts and initial mitigations). Alex will take 02:00-06:00. Samir — can you be the floating backup from 22:00-06:00 in case either of us can't respond?

Samir Patel: I can be floating backup but may have limited connectivity from 23:30-00:30. I'll set my PD to accept notifications and will forward if unreachable.

Alex Chen: I'll update the rotation notes and create the handoff message in PagerDuty. Also adding quick runbook pointer here: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/eu-night

Maya Singh: Pinned runbook checklist (short):
```
1) Check alerts dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts
2) If customer impact suspected: open #incident-bridge and set severity
3) Run `kubectl -n inference get pods` and check model-serving replica counts
4) If latency spike + token failures, flip traffic to fallback-model routing (see routing playbook)
5) Notify Customer Success with the short impact blurb and ETA
```

Oncall Bot: Paging policy reminder: SEV1 => immediate call + page both primary+secondary. SEV2 => page primary and notify secondary via DM. Use `/pager escalate --sev 1` to trigger immediate call.

Maya Singh: Quick note on customer messaging: If it's a regional latency degradation affecting >5% RU in EU, use the CS template: "We're investigating increased inference latency in EU regions; mitigation in progress; next update in 30m." Link: https://internal.redwood.ai/templates/eu-latency

Alex Chen: I'll create the handoff post in PagerDuty with these exact windows and add the bridge link (#incident-bridge) so the on-call sees history. Will also add the crossover check at 02:00: confirm healthy, then call handoff.

Priyanka Rao: Thanks everyone — super appreciate the quick fill. Please react with :thumbsup: once you update PagerDuty so I can mark myself OOO cleanly.

Samir Patel: Done — updated PD and set forwarding. Good luck, all.

Maya Singh: PD updated and pinning runbook in #incident-bridge. I'll be online from 21:45 to prep. Ping me if you need a dry-run of the handoff at 01:45. :raised_hands:

Alex Chen: I'll join 01:50 to confirm metrics and takeover. Thanks team.

Oncall Bot: NOTE: Thread closed for scheduling changes. If new incident pages come in, they will appear on the incident thread for the night.
